logs.rootCause: Baseline telemetry ingestion smoke entry for encounters-render bottleneck.

Cold NixieFX effect instantiation on first combat cast: createDerivedAlphaTexture executed synchronous 2D canvas getImageData readback per emitter instance without global textureProvider.getAlphaTexture caching or boot pool prewarming.

worldView.draw() called encounters.place() and hero.place() which synchronously invoked full encounters.render() + vfx.render() + hero.render() a second time per frame; continuous zoom scale invalidated sprite caches; drawFigureShadow ran per-frame putImageData + destination-canvas blur(1px); 1-frame skew in tracelog.ts attributed phase timings to the next frame dtMs.
Diagnostic simulated frame_spike (simulateDrop) plus uncached figure shadow rasterization when daylight sun vector changed.

8-foe combat with camera follow: duplicate encounters.render() inside worldDraw, unpooled MsdfText FloatViews destroyed every frame, MsdfText live Set memory leak, per-particle occlusionAt scanning all 25 buildings even in the Wilds south of the gate, and inactive pooled NixieFX instances left attached to PixiVfxRenderer.instances.
Repeated 8-foe + Trinity Auto-Cast combat session exhibiting identical worldDraw (66.2ms), encountersStep (15.8ms), encountersRender (42.1ms), and pixiRender (81.2ms) bottlenecks.

Selecting a building on mobile triggered worldView.update(state, id) -> paintWorld() which unconditionally re-ran castShadows(false) (45.2ms) and lighting.capture() (52.5ms of 3x Canvas2D blur passes on static torch bloom/halo) even when building layout and levels had not changed.

Unmeasured hero.loop() and mobile Chrome decoded-image cache eviction on 2932x1606 WebP hero sprite sheets: frameShadowProfile() called profileCtx.drawImage(atlas) + getImageData() on {willReadFrequently: true} canvas when a new animation frame was first visited, triggering synchronous main-thread libwebp re-decode (135-185ms) plus CPU getImageData/putImageData pixel loops on lit in hero.render(). Also gate-doors.ts scheduleFlames() re-ran 4-pass light.shade() every 160ms even when gate was closed or off-screen.

Redundant second paintWorld() at t=3204ms when Co-op room snapshot arrived: worldView.update() computed layout signature from raw net.layout() instead of resolved nextBuilt, causing a false-positive dirty=true when joining a room with identical default buildings.

11-foe Co-op combat with new 18-emitter VFX bundle and 64-entry looks cache: synchronized foe animation frame steps exceeded LOOKS=64 and MAX_SHADOW_CACHE=96, while drawFigureShadow ran an extra destination-canvas blur(1px) filter pass and subpixel occluder keys invalidated cutOut caches.

Opening Choose Your Hero modal at t=51s: ensureView() in hero-picker.ts called ChooseHero.load() without running v.layout() or warming GPU textures in the background, and Pixi GCSystem (gcMaxUnusedTime: 60s) unloaded idle textures. Setting holder.visible = true uploaded + mipmapped 35 @2x textures (including 1672x941 castle-desktop and 1024x1536 hero portraits) on the GPU in a single pixiRender frame.

Switching hero from rift-runner to ember-warden via Begin Journey at t=61.7s: createHero only loaded the initial hero at boot, so setHero("ember-warden") lazily fetched and decoded ember-warden.webp (2852x1364) during gameplay—spending 65.5ms in prewarmAtlasAlpha (SoftwareImageDecodeCache) and 58.0ms on the first GPU-accelerated 2D canvas drawImage (GpuImageDecodeCache).

Walking up to the Stronghold gate (doors.setOpen(true)): full-gateway-v7-sheet.webp (3072x2048, 25.1 MB RGBA) sat unused while closed and was evicted from the browser decoded-image cache; stepping to frame 1 blocked the main thread for 96.2ms (and 108.8ms in seq 76) re-decoding the 3072x2048 sheet and running getAlphaMask on all 16 gate frames.

First combat casts in Firefox 158 (seq 69..74): boot prewarm used autoStart: false without advancing inst.update(0.08), leaving EmitterView Sprite pools empty until the first combat spawn, while multi-hit cues in the same frame called oldest.inst.spawn() (and synchronous drawParticleViews) repeatedly inside encountersStep, compounded by 4x catch-up sub-steps.

Per-swing and per-cast Canvas2D re-rasterization + WebGL texture uploads (seq 67..75): aoeKey included h.state==="attack" and comboHighlightMs>0, invalidating the 800x440 ground AoE reach canvas on every melee swing, while renderZone reset zv.key="" on pool pop and keyed by unquantized angle.toFixed(2) at dpr=2, re-running nested Math.hypot/Math.atan2 dot loops on every skill cast.

Particle explosion and per-frame walkInst regression (seq 77..78, 618..677 active particles, 15..16 liveEffects): commit 2bc97a7 raised ground emitter caps to 6x56=336 particles per ground effect and ran walkInst over all 600+ particles every frame even in the Wilds (anchorY > 860), while clearing occCache whenever the hero moved > 2px.

Post-Wave-4 peer commits (70a77cc, 7e60c99, plus uncommitted HUD Alt-B edits): 7e60c99 raised ground emitter caps in stage.ts back to 14x48=672 particles per ground effect; Hud.setSkills() in Alt-B mode unconditionally executed layoutCrescentArc() every frame during cooldown ticks (destroying/rebuilding Graphics + 6x MsdfText.place() per frame); Hud.setXp() cleared and rebuilt portraitXpRing Graphics every frame; parallax.ts ran 3x 2D simplex noise terrain evaluations every frame in the Wilds; and encounters.ts included f.flash>0 in baseLook (re-painting Revenant canvases + shadows on every hit).
Single-frame compositor/GC pause (100.5ms unaccounted, JS phases <= 2.7ms) after first-visit Choose Your Hero modal close and continuous per-frame HUD/parallax allocations.

Level 10 Ember Warden multi-skill combat with 1518 active particles and 20 liveEffects (seq 81): concurrent peer edit in src/fx/stage.ts raised maxEmitters back to 14 (ground) / 7 (world) and perMax to 48 / 28, causing active particle counts to surge from ~110 to 1518 and encountersStepMs to spike to 18.1ms.

118.6ms encountersRenderMs spike with 8 visible Revenants (seq 82): compose() in encounters.ts copied the cached baseLook canvas onto each foe v.el and called v.canvasView.sync() (WebGL texSubImage2D upload) on every Revenant animation frame advance even when unoccluded (hidden.length===0), while a concurrent peer edit added shimmerStep (changing every 130ms) to the hero AoE baseCacheKey, forcing 2x AoE canvas redraws + 2x WebGL texture uploads 7.7 times per second.

fixesImplemented: src/fx/stage.ts: Global alphaTextures cache, macrotask-sliced boot pool prewarming with autoStart:true + inst.update(0.08) to pre-populate emitter Sprite pools, removeEffect(inst, false) on pooled instances, same-frame spawn dedup (oldest.age < 0.045), emitter/particle caps (<=4 ground x 14 / <=3 world x 12), Wilds fast-path in walkInst, and split staticOccCache vs heroOccCache.

src/stronghold/combat-vfx.ts & src/stronghold/encounters.ts: Cached GPU-uploaded CanvasSprite textures directly in looks (so unoccluded Revenants swap v.canvasView.sprite.texture to the shared GPU texture with zero drawImage or texSubImage2D uploads on animation frames), decoupled shimmerStep from hero AoE baseCacheKey so AoE canvases are not re-uploaded every 130ms, removed f.flash>0 from Revenant baseLook (using sprite.tint=0xff9c84 on hit), lazy-evaluated move() veer candidates without per-frame array allocations, capped same-frame projectile impact cues, cached base dotted AoE zones in zoneBaseCache at quantized 16-way compass angles, preserved zv.key across zonePool reuse, and capped encountersStep catch-up loop to 2 steps.

src/typography/hud.ts & src/stronghold/parallax.ts: Guarded Hud.setSkills() in Alt-B mode with lastArcStructureKey so cooldown ticks only update drawCooldown() instead of rebuilding layoutCrescentArc() every frame; quantized portraitXpRing updates in Hud.setXp() to 1% steps; and added fastAreaAt() + half-tile memoized updateBiomes() in parallax.ts to eliminate 3x per-frame simplex noise terrain generation.

src/stronghold/choose-hero-fx.ts, src/stronghold/choose-hero.ts, src/stronghold/hero-picker.ts: Added stopFx()/stopAll() when Choose Your Hero closes so looping card/button particle instances are released immediately.

src/stronghold/hero.ts: Extracted 1-byte Uint8Array alpha sheet once at load time via prewarmAtlasAlpha(img); preloaded all HEROES at boot; cached lit/unlit hero animation frames in a 48-entry frameCache (cell.w x cell.h); cached pre-scaled cutoutCanvas per environment sprite in cutOut(); removed eager 40-sprite getAlphaMask loop from setScene(); expanded MAX_SHADOW_CACHE to 192.

src/stronghold/gate-doors.ts: Pre-baked scaled sheetCanvas once when full-gateway-v7-sheet.webp loads so opening the gate (setOpen(true)) copies from sheetCanvas in 0.05ms instead of triggering a 96-109ms main-thread WebP re-decode; cached shaded gateway frame for 160ms torch flicker.
src/app/loader.ts, src/typography/frames.ts, src/stronghold/main.ts: Disabled Pixi texture GC and pre-built ChooseHero layout + warmed GPU textures via renderer.texture.initSource().

src/stronghold/world-view.ts & src/stronghold/lighting.ts: Fixed Co-op join signature using resolved nextBuilt, separated shadowsDirty from selection changes, cached staticLights, synced sunKey before first capture in setClockSource, and skipped no-op setShadow(null, 0) repaints.

src/stronghold/tracelog.ts & server/internal/server/tracelog.go: Replaced per-frame getCombatSnapshot() calls in readLiveCounts() with zero-allocation getLiveCounts() (eliminating 60Hz structuredClone + walkable + HUD telemetry allocations), fixed 1-frame phase attribution skew, instrumented hero/party/parallax/gate-doors/lighting phases, classified high-unaccounted spikes as main-thread-longtask / browser-compositor, and persisted fps-tracelogs.jsonl across restarts.
